sources.summary: Czech lighting brand Lasvit has preserved the forms of dried flowers inside hand-blown glass to create a large chandelier in a home in Napa Valley, California, as shown in this video produced by Dezeen for the brand. Called Herbarium, the installation was made from dozens of individually crafted glass pieces suspended at different heights above The post Lasvit suspends chandelier of flowers preserved in glass in Napa Valley home appeared first on Dezeen .
